newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 81,600 MT--a marketing-year low--were 72 percent below the previous week and 86 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for Spain (84,400 MT, 4,700 new sales, 80,500 destination changes, 800 cancellations), South Korea (84,200 MT), Germany (55,000 MT, all destination changes), and Thailand (34,500 MT) were partially offset by reductions for Taiwan (106,900 MT), unknown destinations (85,900 MT), and France (55,000 MT).

Exports of 555,600 MT were 23 percent less than the previous week and 30 percent under the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Spain (84,400 MT), Belgium (56,000 MT), Taiwan (55,100 MT), Germany (55,000 MT), and the Netherlands (45,900 MT).
